name: Tewa (USA)

ancestors.notes: Descent per Glottolog classification of Rio Grande Tewa (tewa1260).

notes: Skeleton. Kiowa-Tanoan (Tewa) language of the Rio Grande pueblos of New Mexico in a practical Roman orthography. Aspirated stops (ph th kh), ejectives with a following apostrophe, labialized kw/gw, v=[β] and the affricates ts/ch are mapped. Tewa is tonal with contrastive vowel nasalization; tone and nasalization are not reliably recovered from this spelling and are left unencoded, raising the PER floor. Tewa has a three-tone system rather than contrastive stress; descriptions of Tewa consistently omit tonal distinctions from the orthography, so tone is left unencoded here (documented exemption).
